test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Has her family __being informed__ about the event?
solution:
The correct answer is **'been informed'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the **Present Perfect **tense.
 
• So the structure should be: Past participle form of 'be' + V3 i.e been informed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Present Perfect Tense is used to describe an event that started in the past and the impact of the event is continuing in the present.
 
 
• Example- Her family has been informed about the event.
